title: •Well-earned Command
caption: •Well-earned Command (V)
game_text: Deploy on a battleground site. At sites where you have a vehicle with armor and an Imperial general (or Imperial commander), your total battle destiny is +3 and opponent may not draw more than two battle destiny. If opponent controls this site, this Effect lost.
lore: Imperial officers often simulate large-scale battles with hologram games to improve their tactical ability. Those who excel at these games often mark themselves for advancement.

'hologram' is a word Decipher often bolds, but bold is not discernible on the 350 px scan, so left plain. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright = Endor line (1999), not legible.
